title: Experiment Tracking & a Model Registry
summary: Track experiment runs with reproducible fingerprints, pick the best run, register versioned models, promote them through Staging and Production safely, and roll back in one call.

hints.test_log_run_ids_and_storage: Hand out ids 'run-1', 'run-2', … and store copies of params and metrics, so a caller mutating its dict later can't change history.
hints.test_fingerprint_is_order_independent: Hash a canonical form: json.dumps(params, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')), then sha256 hexdigest.
hints.test_duplicate_runs_are_detectable: Group runs by fingerprint. Any fingerprint with more than one run is a repeated experiment.
hints.test_best_run_max_and_min: Skip runs that don't have the metric. For mode='min' pick the smallest. On ties keep the earliest run.
hints.test_register_versions_per_model: Versions count up from 1 separately for each model name. Each new version starts in stage 'None'.
hints.test_promotion_archives_previous_product: Only one version may be in Production. Promoting a new one moves the old one to 'Archived'.
hints.test_invalid_transitions: Reject unknown stages with ValueError. Unknown models or versions raise KeyError.
hints.test_rollback_restores_previous_producti: Remember which version was in Production before. Rollback re-promotes it and archives the current one.
hints.test_rollback_without_history_fails: Raise ValueError when there's no previous Production version to go back to.
